title: Initial Build Offer · Conquistadors ↔ Badland Banditos

analysis.executiveSummary: Conquistadors (Elite Contender, goal: Win Championship) seek to acquire Houston Texans year-two WR Jayden Higgins (23 years old, C-AVI: 53.6, D-AVI: 81.4) from Badland Banditos (Playoff Push, goal: Increase Championship Odds). Badland Banditos carry severe RB structural vulnerability with only two startable running backs on their roster. Offering RB Tyjae Spears (C-AVI: 50.6, D-AVI: 72.5) along with a 2027 2nd-round pick (Northside Kings, AVI: 48.5) directly fixes Badland Banditos' critical RB depth crisis while providing future draft liquidity, making this a highly realistic (80% acceptance probability) proposal that upgrades Conquistadors' long-term dynasty ceiling.

submitted.summary: Conquistadors leverage redundant RB depth (Spears is RB3 behind Bijan and Achane) and a mid-round pick to secure a high-ceiling 23-year-old WR in Jayden Higgins (+8.9 D-AVI upgrade). Badland Banditos resolve a roster hole at RB3/FLEX while adding liquid draft equity.

recommended.summary: This offer aligns perfectly with both front offices' strategic goals: Conquistadors solidify long-term dynasty asset quality, while Badland Banditos secure essential running back insurance and draft liquidity without abandoning their current playoff push.

overall.summary: Conquistadors turn RB depth and future draft capital into a premium 23-year-old dynasty WR with breakout potential.
